provenance.measurement_wall_timestamp_reason: Only monotonic per-request offsets were recorded; metadata capture time is not measurement start/end.

authority.delegation: existing root-owned user slice with cpu memory pids enabled
authority.changes: only uniquely named child cgroups created and removed; shared controller configuration unchanged
authority.membership: supervisor moves before namespace fork and worker exec; descendants inherit cgroup; observer remains outside
authority.cpu_scope: cgroup cpu.stat usage_usec, multiplied by 1000; excludes supervisor pre-migration CPU
authority.memory_scope: cgroup memory.peak charges since cgroup creation; anonymous, file and kernel charges, not RSS; existing shared charges can belong elsewhere

provenance.method_source_note: collect.py gained overflow-queue bounding and explicit broken-pipe close after collection; successful request timing and accounting paths are unchanged.
